originality.rationale: Direct comparison of statements finds no inspected paper establishing the conditional-iid false-twin precision formula together with the exact positive-weight threshold and the zero-weight clique/nonclique boundary. These conclusions are stronger and differently parameterized than mixing or influence bounds. General covariance Schur identities themselves are not novel; uninspected earlier equivalent Potts algebra is a live priority risk.
residual_risks: An earlier unlocated inverse susceptibility or Potts marginalization theorem may imply the identity and strictness as a corollary.
The graph-clique criterion might be implicitly derivable from established conditional-independence theory of Potts projections.
The iff claim at zero temperature is explicitly restricted to q at least |V|; intermediate palettes are not classified.

Borgs and Chayes, The covariance matrix of the Potts model: A random cluster analysis (arXiv:adap-org/9411001), studies lattice-model covariance eigenvalues; only its abstract was examined here, so earlier implicit finite-graph consequences are not excluded.

value.rationale: A sharp neighborhood-clique dependence boundary determines when a one-color Potts observable has a zero full precision entry, including a positive-temperature discontinuity of its zero pattern. This graph structural classification and general residual-variance sign identity address a motivated dependence question beyond a routine special-case parameter calculation.
